events.text:
Small-parts organizer built with 7 distinct hex cells, each with its own bin, in a compact honeycomb cluster.

**Configuration:** 7 bases in a flower (center + 6 neighbors) hosting 7 bins: 1× full-div2 (2 compartments), 1× full-div3 (3 comp), 1× full, 1× half-div2, 1× half-div3, 1× third-div2, 1× third-div3 – providing varied compartment sizes for small-parts sorting. All meshClash clear.

*Evidence counts as 7 separate bins; compartment dividers are internal to each bin. Warning LOOSE_BODY is non-error (joint bolts optional).*
